decisive_items: brownish macules on the hands and feet
hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
response.rationale: The combination of gastrointestinal polyps and mucocutaneous melanin deposits is characteristic of Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome.

rejected.why: No clear evidence of immune-mediated damage or malabsorption specific to celiac disease
Insufficient evidence of granulomatous inflammation or skip lesions characteristic of Crohn's disease
Limited evidence of autoimmune enteropathy and lack of specific antibodies
